First Sung on תשמ״ח‎ (1988) in honor of the Rebbe's 86 th birthday
First sung by Reb Aharon Blesofsky
The lyrics are from. " This mizmor of Tehillim was composed to be sung in the Beis Hamikdash. It praises the glory of Yerushalayim, a city that produces great chachamim and people who do good things
The Rebbe requested that this niggun be sung by all the chayolim at the Tzivos Hashem rally held on the third day of Chol Hamoed

Where We'll Be

Tzvi sits at the kitchen table, staring at the calendar.

He can handle today, or most of it (the part that's already passed). But what about tomorrow? Next week? What about Mishnayos tests and chavrusas?

more than all the dwellings of Yaakov (the rest of Eretz Yisroel).

He watches his mother grate cheese over a pan of macaroni. "Mommy, how can you prepare dinner right now if Moshiach can come any second?"

And of Tzion it is said,

And He, the most High, will preserve it.

home, the home of our neshama, is in Yerushalayim, where we are closest to Hashem, Who loves us."

Mommy finishes and says, "The words mention how different people were born there."

"Exactly!" says Tzvi. "I want to be in Yerushalayim, davening Mincha in the Beis Hamikdash, instead of staring at this Golus calendar."

"But I wasn't born there," says Tzvi, feeling left out.

"True," says his mother. "We were born in Golus. But our real

"Well, soon you won't have to worry about that calendar any more. We will be in Yerushalayim, with the Rebbe leading us. And for calendar events, or even just for dinner, we will know exactly where we will be!"
